title: From Copying to Composition: How Language Models Develop In-Context Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) allows language models to adapt their behavior from instructions and demonstrations in a prompt, but accuracy alone does not reveal how contextual information controls their predictions. We study the acquisition and trainability of ICL with a controlled diagnostic that separates copying a nearby demonstration from integrating information across the prompt. Across 17 models, about a third prefer the copied answer, a few are undecided, and the rest prefer the rule-consistent answer, which goes with higher accuracy and with control by the requested value rather than the closest conflicting example. Checkpoint analyses show that models begin prioritizing task-relevant prompt tokens over conflicting examples long before their accuracy improves beyond chance level. translated_title: 从复制到组合：语言模型如何发展出上下文学习能力
translated_abstract: 上下文学习使语言模型能够根据提示中的指令和示例调整自身行为，但仅凭准确率无法揭示上下文信息是如何控制模型预测的。我们通过一个受控诊断方法研究ICL的习得与可训练性，该方法将“复制提示中最近的示例”与“整合提示中跨上下文的信息”区分开来。在17个模型中，约三分之一的模型倾向于复制答案，少数模型摇摆不定，其余模型则倾向于符合规则的答案，这与更高的准确率相关，且其预测受所请求的值控制而非受最近的冲突示例控制。检查点分析表明，模型在准确率超越随机水平之前很早就开始优先处理与任务相关的提示词元，而非冲突示例。在匹配训练实验中，先定义词尾再查询词尾的合成文档使模型在受控诊断上转向组合式响应。
tldr: 该研究通过受控诊断方法发现，语言模型会从倾向于复制提示中最近示例，逐渐发展为整合提示信息进行组合式推理的上下文学习，且这种转变出现得很早，并可通过特定的合成数据训练加以引导。
en_tdlr: Using a controlled diagnostic, this study shows that language models develop from copying the nearest in-prompt demonstration to compositional, rule-consistent in-context learning—a transition that emerges early in training and can be induced with targeted synthetic data.
